in_marathi.name: Krithvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Creativity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krithvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Krithvika is the presiding deity of creativity, arts, and crafts. She is a patron of writers, poets, artists, and musicians.

in_bengali.name: Krithvika
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Creativity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Krithvika একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess Krithvika is the presiding deity of creativity, arts, and crafts. She is a patron of writers, poets, artists, and musicians.

vedic_reference.note: The name Krithvika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Krith’ which means ‘to do’, ‘to make’, or ‘to create’. This name is for a girl who is expected to bring change and create a positive impact in the world.
